name: DOCUMENT_PARSER
description: Parses various document formats (PDF, DOCX, etc.) using Apache Tika to extract text, HTML, metadata, and potentially tables.

parameters.name: inputKey
parameters.description: The key in the input Data object that holds the document content as a byte array.

parameters.name: outputKeyPrefix
parameters.description: The prefix for keys in the output Data object where parsed content will be stored (e.g., if 'parsedDoc', outputs might be 'parsedDoc.text', 'parsedDoc.metadata').

parameters.name: extractionTypes
parameters.description: A list of strings specifying what content to extract. Multiple types can be provided.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Optional password for opening encrypted documents (e.g., password-protected PDFs).

parameters.name: tikaConfigPath
parameters.description: Optional path to a custom Tika configuration XML file (tika-config.xml). If not provided, default Tika configuration is used.
